name: Bandmaster_1
short_caption: The robot acts as an orchestral conductor, waving its arms rhythmically to lead an imaginary performance.
movement_description: Starting from a neutral posture, the robot raises both hands to chest height and begins gesturing in a rhythmic, conducting pattern. It alternates between sweeping gestures with both arms, tapping its hand in front of the chest, and raising a single arm as if cuing an instrument section, while tilting and turning its head to follow the music. The sequence culminates in a dramatic, symmetric upward sweep of both arms that meets above its head before bringing both arms down smoothly back to its sides.
safety_notes: The robot performs wide lateral and high vertical arm movements, requiring a clear radius of about 1 meter around the upper body.
